name: SorStaking
report: The getPendingRewards function incorrectly calculates rewards based on the total deposited amount rather than the withdrawn amount. As a result, an attacker could repeatedly withdraw 1 token and receive full pending rewards each time, draining approximately $43,000.
report_zh: getPendingRewards 函数错误地基于总存入金额而非提款金额计算奖励。因此，攻击者可以每次提取 1 个代币并重复获得全部待定奖励，从而盗取约 43,000 美元。
